summary_md: **Harshith Sai Batthini ([@Harshithsai939](https://x.com/Harshithsai939/status/2115647313762812158))** introduces **jevgrep**, a CLI that hands coding agents the relevant files with line numbers by asking what code *does*. On 10 real tasks he reports Claude Code's bill falling from about $7.62 to $5.44 with the same 8/10 solved.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - dzhng/jevgrep: Find code by asking what it does. A CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context.

relevance: Context-retrieval tooling that measurably cuts agent token spend without hurting success.
